verses.restored: Give ear to my words, O YHWH, consider my meditation.

familiar.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

modern.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד אֲמָרַ֖י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְהוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִֽיגִי

verses.restored: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

familiar.text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

modern.text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

original.text: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל

verses.restored: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O YHWH; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

familiar.text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

modern.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.

original.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה

verses.restored: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

familiar.text: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

modern.text: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.

original.text: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א אֵֽל חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע

verses.restored: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

familiar.text: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

modern.text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.

original.text: לֹֽא יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן

verses.restored: Thou shalt destroy them that speak falsehood: YHWH will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

familiar.text: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

modern.text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

original.text: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

familiar.text: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

modern.text: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל הֵֽיכַל קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Lead me, O YHWH, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

familiar.text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

modern.text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.

original.text: יְהוָ֤ה נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הושר לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

familiar.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

modern.text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.

original.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן

verses.restored: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

familiar.text: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

modern.text: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

original.text: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ

verses.restored: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

familiar.text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

modern.text: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

original.text: וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: For thou, YHWH, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

familiar.text: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

modern.text: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.

original.text: כִּֽי אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֪ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Requests for an enemy’s downfall are lament language, not permission for personal retaliation or sacred violence.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
